### Modifications in Each File

- **File Modified:** `TestHadoopArchives.java`
  - **Change Made:** The condition in the while loop was modified from `if (read < 0)` to `if (read <= 0)`. This change alters the logic to consider both the case where no bytes are read (i.e., `read == 0`) and the end of the stream (i.e., `read < 0`) as indicators to exit the loop.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `TestHadoopArchives.java` is aimed at fixing a timeout issue (HADOOP-13798) by enhancing the logic that determines when to stop reading from the input stream. By adjusting the condition to include `read == 0`, the patch prevents the loop from running indefinitely in scenarios where no further data is available, thus addressing the timeout problem.
